nodes.title: SG-2 Author inventory item icon sources and register them
nodes.body:
Context: the last check found SG-2 unmet only because no inventory item icons exist. The art sources (game/frontend/src/art) hold the room, boy, secret door and dust grids, but nothing for items, and the manifest (game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json) has no item entries. Desired behavior: palette-indexed icon grids for at least six items (enough for the 3x2 inventory grid) are authored, generated to PNG by the existing art:generate script, registered at their declared size, and covered by the existing manifest palette and size test. Why: the SG-2 'Done when' lists inventory item icons explicitly.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the art sources, When generateAssets runs, Then at least six ids with the prefix item/ are produced as single-frame PNGs.
- Given the committed manifest, When compared to generated entries, Then every item/ entry matches exactly and each PNG size equals its declared dimensions.
- Given every item icon frame, When converted through the palette, Then every pixel is a palette colour and no svg is referenced.


## Scope
- In scope: Item icon grid sources
- In scope: Generating the PNGs and manifest entries with art:generate
- In scope: Extending the manifest palette and size test to the icons
- Out of scope: Rendering icons in the Story Panel inventory grid
- Out of scope: New rooms, new story content, backend changes, audio, deployment, repository clean-up
- Out of scope: Rebuilding the room, boy or interface art that already exists
- Preserve: Existing ART_SOURCES entries and their committed manifest entries
- Preserve: Phaser 3.90.x pin and the existing guard tests
- Preserve: Shared palette of at most 48 colours


## Technical constraints
- All art is raster pixel art generated in the repo from source data by the deterministic art:generate script; no downloaded art or image services.
- One shared palette of at most 48 colours, defined once in game/frontend/src/lib/palette.ts.
- Tests are unit tests with all dependencies mocked.
- Phaser stays on 3.90.x; React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, Radix and Zustand stay.


## Definition of done
- All requirements below are met and their Verify units pass.


## Non-functional requirements
- Generation is deterministic: identical input gives identical bytes.


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Six palette-indexed item icon grids exist at 16x16
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/src/art/sources.ts exports ART_SOURCES from BOY_SOURCES, ROOM_SOURCES and SCENE_EXTRA_SOURCES; grids use draw.ts helpers (createGrid, fillRect, outlineRect, shadeRect, rampIndex). Desired behavior: a new itemIcons module defines six 16x16 grids (old-key, note, book, coin, flashlight, photo) with an indigo outline and ramp shading, exported as ITEM_SOURCES with ids item/<name> and spread into ART_SOURCES. Why: the 3x2 inventory grid needs icons for six items.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given ITEM_SOURCES, When listed, Then it has six sources with unique ids item/old-key, item/note, item/book, item/coin, item/flashlight and item/photo.
- Given each item source, When its frame is read, Then it is a single 16x16 grid containing the outline index and at least two ramp shades.
- Given ART_SOURCES, When listed, Then it contains all six item sources.


## Scope
- In scope: New src/art/itemIcons.ts
- In scope: Spreading ITEM_SOURCES into ART_SOURCES
- Out of scope: Inventory UI rendering
- Out of scope: Changing game state or content item definitions
- Preserve: Existing source ids and ordering of earlier sources


## Technical constraints
- Grids are pure functions built from draw.ts helpers using indices from the shared palette.
- Constraint: one shared palette of at most 48 colours.


## Dependencies
- INT


## Definition of done
- itemIcons module and ART_SOURCES wiring exist and type-check.


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Item icon PNGs are generated and registered in the manifest at declared size
nodes.body:
Context: art:generate (game/frontend/scripts/generateArt.ts) writes PNGs under game/public/assets and merges entries into worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json; tests/sceneArtSources.test.ts compares generated entries with the committed manifest and checks palette and PNG sizes. Desired behavior: after running art:generate, six item/ entries with 16x16 dimensions are committed with their PNGs, and sceneArtSources.test.ts explicitly asserts them. Why: the criterion asks for icons registered in the manifest and covered by the existing test.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the committed manifest, When item/ entries are listed, Then six image entries have dimensions 16x16 and paths ending .png under worlds/the-boys-room/items/.
- Given the generated files, When PNG headers are read, Then each item PNG size equals its manifest dimensions.
- Given the manifest, When scanned, Then no path ends in .svg.


## Scope
- In scope: Running art:generate
- In scope: Committed manifest item entries and PNG files
- In scope: Extending tests/sceneArtSources.test.ts
- Out of scope: Inventory UI rendering
- Preserve: Existing manifest entries unchanged


## Technical constraints
- Manifest is only updated by the deterministic art:generate script, not hand-edited.


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- Manifest and PNGs committed in sync with sources.


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: Act: Author item icon grids and add them to ART_SOURCES
nodes.body:
Create game/frontend/src/art/itemIcons.ts following the pattern of sceneExtras.ts (ArtSource entries built from draw.ts helpers) and spread the result into ART_SOURCES in sources.ts so the existing generator picks it up.

## Acceptance criteria
- itemIcons.ts exports ITEM_ICON_SIZE (16), six grid functions and ITEM_SOURCES with six entries.
- sources.ts spreads ITEM_SOURCES into ART_SOURCES after SCENE_EXTRA_SOURCES.
- Each grid uses rampIndex colours and an indigo step 0 outline, with no hardcoded raw indices other than 0 for transparent.


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/art/itemIcons.ts
- In scope: game/frontend/src/art/sources.ts
- Out of scope: Tests
- Out of scope: Generated PNGs
- Preserve: ArtSource interface and existing sources


## Technical constraints
- Shared palette only, via rampIndex from src/art/draw.ts.
- New file: `game/frontend/src/art/itemIcons.ts`
- Code path: `game/frontend/src/art/sources.ts`


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- npm run typecheck passes in game/frontend for the new module.


## Clarifying questions
- None
